notes: Official Agent City Application Icon: adds the shared multi-resolution Windows ICO used by both the desktop shortcut and notification-area tray. The icon contains 16, 24, 32, 48, 64, 128, and 256 px RGBA frames, with a simplified city/network silhouette designed to stay readable at tray size, transparent outer corners, and strong contrast on both light and dark Windows UI. The existing launcher and tray already consume static/assets/app/agent-city.ico, so no launcher behavior changes are required. This is application branding only and introduces no Simulation, Memory, Communication, or physical-authority changes.
